We conduct extensive experiments on the LLaMA2-7Bchat and Vicuna-v1.5-7B models, evaluating VATP across 16 long-context tasks from the LongBench benchmark.

The Longbench benchmark consists of 16 English tasks, each containing between 150 and 500 samples. This benchmark encompasses a diverse array of long-text tasks, including question answering, text summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, and code completion.
